prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: the renewal price went up. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 1)
